description: Header file defining internal data structures and classes for operator registration and dispatching in PyTorch, including OperatorEntry, AnnotatedKernel, and related methods.

classes.name: OperatorEntry
classes.description: Represents an internal record of a registered operator, managing schemas, kernels, and dispatch logic.

classes.name: AnnotatedKernel
classes.description: Contains metadata about a registered kernel, including the kernel function, inferred schema, and debug info.

classes.name: AnnotatedSchema
classes.description: Holds operator schema with debug info about registration location.

methods.name: registerKernel
methods.description: Registers a kernel for an operator with specified dispatch key and associated metadata.

methods.name: deregisterKernel_
methods.description: Deregisters a kernel for a specific dispatch key.

methods.name: updateFallback
methods.description: Updates fallback behavior for a dispatch key.

methods.name: hasKernelForDispatchKey
methods.description: Checks if a kernel exists for a specific dispatch key.

methods.name: kernelForDispatchKey
methods.description: Retrieves the kernel function for a specific dispatch key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns operator tags associated with registration.
